scope: BG1 frozen conditional small-TT global nonlinear constraint family at fixed positive nonround Berger gamma and fixed Lambda=R/2+3h^2, both h signs, h nonzero
exposure_order: Author freeze notification, reviewer source-first seal, seal-existence notice, authorized direct exposure and review
evidence_limitations: The hard-coded exp(-6t) assertion is arithmetic bookkeeping, not an independent Cotton transformation-law test.
General Fredholm, Schauder, Banach IFT and quasilinear regularity are mathematical methods with hypotheses checked analytically; finite algebra does not certify these theorems.
Post-exposure author replays are regression and reproducibility, not independent implementations.
Exact backend/model diversity is untested; the distinct implementations share SymPy.
Reviewer auxiliary exact Killing-vector family remains reviewer-only reconstruction and is not an additional independently reviewed author result.
maximum_survivor: Actual smooth global fixed-gamma fixed-Lambda solutions from every sufficiently small smooth TT seed near h gamma, conditional on the existing G310/G312 arena and with trace determined by the original constraints.
excluded: Uniform smallness radius toward h=0 or roundness
All distant constraint data or complete global moduli
Reproduction of a prescribed local seed
Global time persistence or closed-orbit persistence
Physical stability, source, action, matter, scale or selection
Scientific premise adoption, accepted-grade promotion or canon
